court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before S. Sounthar and P.B. Balaji, JJ.)
respondents: Additional Chief Secretary to the Government Home Prohibition and Excise Department and Others … Respondent(s).
advocates: For Petitioner(s) : Mr. J. William Shakesphere
For Respondent(s) : Mr. S. Raja Kumar, Additional Public Prosecutor.
judgment_text:
Prayer : This Writ Petition (Criminal) filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking issuance of writ of mandamus directing the 3rd respondent herein to take the petitioner, namely, Hari Nadar @ Hari son of Arunachalam Nadar, who has detained as Goonda as per the detention order BCDFGISSSV No. 26 of 2026 detained in 3rd respondent prison to the Government or Private Hospital for further treatment to his aliment at petitioners own cost by considering petitioners representation dated 28-4-2026.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

S. Sounthar, J.:— This Writ Petition has been filed seeking a direction to the third respondent to take the petitioner, who was detained under the Goondas Act, to the Government or Private hospital for further treatment regarding his ailments. In this regard, the petitioner submitted a representation on 28-4-2026 to the 4th respondent through the 3rd respondent with the copy marked to the other respondents.

2. Mr S. Raja Kumar, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, who takes notice for the respondents would submit that the representation of the petitioner will be considered in accordance with law.

3. In view of the above submission, this Court, without expressing any opinion on merits of the matter, directs the third respondent to consider the representation of the petitioner dated 28-4-2026 and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law, within a period of two weeks from today.

4. With the above direction, this writ petition is disposed of.
